User defined families

Source: R/scoring.R
custom_family.Rd

Builds a family from a log density (or log mass) so that every engine path that needs only the likelihood (maximum likelihood, random effects, penalties, prediction by numerical inversion, scoring) works with it. The normalization is checked numerically at check parameter values.

Usage

custom_family(
  id,
  pars,
  lpdf,
  discrete = FALSE,
  support = NULL,
  cdf = NULL,
  quantile = NULL,
  rng = NULL,
  mean = NULL,
  variance = NULL,
  stan = NULL,
  check = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

id

Identifier.

pars

List of parameters from par_spec().

lpdf

Function (y, p) returning log densities, vectorized over y and the parameter vectors in p.

discrete

Whether the law is discrete.

support

Optional function of the parameters returning list(lower, upper).

cdf, quantile, rng, mean, variance

Optional functions.

stan

Optional Stan template from the registry helpers.

check

Optional named list of parameter values at which total mass is verified.

...

Further arguments to the family constructor.

Value

A regcomp_family.

Examples

f <- custom_family("my_exp", list(par_spec("rate", "positive", role = "rate")),
  lpdf = function(y, p) dexp(y, p$rate, log = TRUE),
  support = function(p) list(lower = 0, upper = Inf), check = list(rate = 2))
set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(y = rexp(100, 2))
coef(regcomp(y ~ 1, family = f, data = d))
#> rate:(Intercept) 
#>        0.6629319
